subject: planner: keep hist unchanged when deriving limit stats (#62537)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent. `util.DeriveLimitStats` now preserves `StatsInfo.HistColl` when deriving LIMIT/TopN stats (no mutation, just retains child pointer) to avoid dropping histogram metadata during costing. `applyLogicalTopNAndLimitHint` now returns `false` when a prefer-pushdown hint is present but the child task isn’t a `CopTask`, preventing threshold-based preference from incorrectly treating non-cop tasks as preferred. No Blocker/High correctness/semantics/concurrency issues found; later history shows subsequent refactors in this area without indicating a remaining bug in this change.
